name: opencode-suite-install-v2
body:
`apg init` installs the opencode 2.x suite. In addition to the shared lib, the upgrade guide, and the seven distributed agents, it installs the tool plugins into the opencode 2.x plugin location `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` under the global opencode config directory, and writes `~/.config/opencode/package.json` with the `@opencode/plugin` dependency, running `npm install` under `~/.config/opencode/` when that dependency is missing from `node_modules`. The installed plugin files load under opencode 2.x from that location (through the `plugins` config entry or the discovery directory to which the global config directory resolves). The install is idempotent (`rust.apg.install.write_if_changed`) and prunes apg-owned files outside the plugin set, so an install root carried over from a V1 layout ends at the V2 plugin set.

The install surface keeps its other properties: the duplicate-install warning quietens nothing (a project `.opencode/` file that duplicates an installed suite file still draws the loud warning, and `apg init` deletes nothing — `solution.constraint.duplicate-install-warning-preserved`), and the distributed-agent embed/install/prune surface (`solution.component.distributed-agent-install`) is unchanged in membership.

Acceptance criteria: `rust.apg.install`'s embedded-file registry carries the tool plugins and installs them into `~/.config/opencode/plugins/`; `OPENCODE_PACKAGE_JSON` names the `@opencode/plugin` dependency; the `npm install` trigger checks for `@opencode/plugin` under `node_modules`; the stale-prune covers the apg-owned files outside the plugin set; the duplicate-install warning behaviour is unchanged.
